title: Companion regard shifts are never flagged in the line where they happen. Promising the reeve to seal the barrow (a direct choice) never said Brother Osk disliked it; I only discovered his regard had already dropped to -1 by checking status many turns later.
where: Last Light Square, reeve dialogue 'promise to seal the barrow' vs. later status screen (Party: Brother Osk regard -1)
